name: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview
description: Legacy preview text-to-speech model offering low-latency speech generation with steerable prompts and expressive audio tags for precise narration control. Google recommends Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS or Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for new and production workloads.

sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS Preview model page
sources.notes: Preview model code and the 8,192 input / 16,384 output token limits. The page states the model is legacy and recommends the 3.8 TTS models.

sources.title: Gemini Developer API pricing
sources.notes: Standard tier: $1.00 text input, $20.00 audio output per 1M tokens.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.notes: Recommended replacements are gemini-3.8-flash-tts or gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts. No shutdown date announced.
